expectation: Cytoplasmic granular stain in a minority of cells: scattered single cytotoxic T/NK cells in lamina propria/stroma and between epithelial cells, a little denser in lymphoid aggregates; a small subset of CD8a+ cells, with unstained tissue between them.
notes: GZMB lights the whole mucosa and stroma as a smooth haze that traces the tissue's architecture, with stripe artefacts and bright blobs; no distinct granular cells. In E it does not pick out CD8a cells.
observed: A: diffuse glow follows the mucosa and tissue outline, with horizontal stripes in the background. B/C: smooth haze over the stroma around the epithelium, no discrete cells. D: haze plus one off-cell blob. E: GZMB is a uniform haze over CD8a+ and CD8a− areas alike; only a debris blob shows green.
why: The signal is tissue-wide haze and autofluorescence with artefacts, not a distinct granular subset of cells that sits on CD8a cells.
